tool_call.why: To retrieve the monthly price movement for Southeast Asia propylene since January 2024, and check for gaps or changes in the price assessment basis.

reason: The section requires evidence of monthly price movement and assessment continuity for Southeast Asia propylene since 2024. The price series inventory confirms two relevant series: spot (2024-01 to 2025-12) and contract (2026-01 to 2026-08). Querying these will provide the needed data and reveal any gaps or changes.
